Thank you for requesting information from Winnie Palmer Hospital!
If you'd like to schedule an appointment, we've made it easy through our Request a Consultation tool (http://www.winniepalmerhospital.com/microsites/winnieknows/request-consultation). All you need to do is provide some basic information, including your name, birthdate, phone number and address. Within 48 hours, a representative will contact you to confirm a date and time. It's that easy!
Once your appointment is confirmed, you'll want to have a few things ready for your visit:
- You may want a family member or friend to accompany you in order to help you remember the information you discuss with your physician - Your insurance information - A list of questions you want to ask the physician - Request any relevant medical records from your health care provider
If you have questions about finding a physician, you can reach us at 321.843.7626.
